newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates edge higher.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates edge higher.

text.p: Jordan overnight dinar rates edged a touch higher on Tuesday in a 7.75-8.00 percent range with demand outstripping supply in a tight dinar market, dealers said.

A tight market has persisted since start of weekly trade on Saturday with excess dinar funds absorbed after some banks tied up funds in the last 15 million dinar CD (certificate of deposit) auction, bankers said.
Excess liquidity sent rates tumbling to a low 3.00 percent average last week.
Rates hovered in a 7.50-8.00 percent on Monday.
